description: This file defines the EchoSqlLogger class, which implements the SQLLogger interface from Doctrine DBAL. It logs SQL queries, their parameters, and types to standard output, primarily for debugging purposes within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: EchoSqlLogger
classes.description: A logger class that outputs executed SQL queries and their parameters/types to standard output for debugging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the logger with an optional replace flag.

methods.name: startQuery
methods.description: Logs the SQL query string, parameters, and types (if provided).

methods.name: stopQuery
methods.description: Method required by SQLLogger interface, does nothing in this implementation.
